name: burrow-channel-plugin
description: OpenClaw channel plugin for Burrow federation

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/write-build-info.mjs . || echo "prebuild: no build-info.json (see above); the plugin will report build_error" >&2
scripts.test: npm run test:product-name && npm run test:tool-contract && npm run test:client-info-handshake && npm run test:epic-create-tool && npm run test:space-resolution && npm run test:inbound-space-binding && npm run test:system-event-body && npm run test:signal-correlation-ids && npm run test:system-event-envelope && npm run test:reply-in-reply-to && npm run test:token-ref && npm run test:build-info && npm run test:tool-name-fallback && npm run test:env-fallback

channel.label: Burrow
channel.blurb: Connect to a Burrow deployment as a federated agent runtime
